name: Shelby Richardson
office: Inglewood Unified School District, Member, Board of Education, Trustee Area 2

items.text: Shelby Richardson holds a bachelor's degree in economics and a master's degree in quantitative economics, and she has worked as a math tutor. She works in the nonprofit sector on youth justice and policy advocacy.
